messages:
maria-support: Heads-up — customer 'ClipIt' reports SSE stream drops mid-request during iOS Wi‑Fi handover. They see a 499 (client_closed) on our side and a subsequent 401 on a reconnect attempt. Happened for 3 users this morning after token refresh. Repro steps below.

elaine-support: @maria-support can you paste the request_id and SDK version? also any sample logs from the device? :pray:

maria-support: request_id=cli-79f2a, sdk=ios-0.9.4. Logs attached from user (snip):
```
[2026-03-16T09:12:34.123Z] SSE open (token_exp: 2026-03-16T09:12:39Z)
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.200Z] network-change: cellular->wifi
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.310Z] socket closed: net::ERR_SOCKET_NOT_CONNECTED
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.315Z] sdk: refreshing token
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.318Z] reconnect attempt #1
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.320Z] response 401 for /events (invalid_token)
[2026-03-16T09:12:39.325Z] server emitted 499 for cli-79f2a
```

jon-eng: This looks like a timing/race where the client closes the socket during the network switch, then the SDK immediately tries to refresh and reconnect using a token that the server already treated as invalid (maybe TTL drift). Two angles: client-side ordering of close->refresh->reconnect, and our auth window tolerance.

jon-eng: Quick checks: reproduce with token expiring in <10s, force network handoff, capture device console + server logs. For mitigation, increase accept-window for recently-expired tokens by ~500ms and add server-side idempotent reconnect handling.

sanjay-plat: @jon-eng we currently allow 150ms auth skew. If the client refreshes and reconnects within 20ms but the initial socket close arrives after reconnect, we might issue a 401 because lookup used old cache. I'll run a trace on auth cache invalidation.

customer-dev: fwiw, from the app side we see the sequence: socket error -> SDK token refresh -> new SSE open. The socket error happens before the refresh completes (short network handoff). We can throttle reconnect so refresh completes first, but want to know if server can tolerate quick reconnects during handoffs.

elaine-support: Repro steps I wrote and sent to customer: 1) issue SSE with token TTL=5s 2) trigger Wi‑Fi <-> cellular switch 3) observe socket abort + immediate SDK token refresh 4) see 499 then 401. Can you confirm?

jon-eng: Confirmed repro locally on simulator with token=5s TTL. Also saw net::ERR_SOCKET_NOT_CONNECTED then immediate reconnect which hit 401. Patch to SDK quick-fix: wait 150ms after socket error before starting token refresh + reconnect. Might reduce UX for some users.

maria-support: Action items: 1) Ask customer to enable debug SDK logs and attach device console (we need full RTT). 2) Platform: evaluate increasing auth skew to 500ms and log any out-of-order socket events. 3) Eng: consider server-side safe-reconnect that treats reconnect within 300ms as continuation when request_id matches.

dev-bot: incident created INC-9876 (streaming/499-401-race). Linked to ticket ENG-4562.

jon-eng: I'll take ENG-4562. Short term: platform can enable temporary 500ms tolerance (config flag). Long term: add idempotent reconnect handshake (client sends prev_conn_id header).

customer-dev: thanks — we'll try the SDK backoff on our end and send logs. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
